_comment: Third-party Herdr app mods that herdr-app/extras.py installs, each pinned to the commit whose code was reviewed. Order matters: herdr-nvim takes the Files slot and filetree then takes it over; better-tabs takes the tab bar. Bump a ref only after reading the new code.

herdr-nvim.about: Neovim beside your agents (cmd-e, cmd-o, cmd-shift-e). Its installer downloads the herdr-nvim binary of the release into ~/.local/share/herdr-nvim, checked against its SHA-256, and edits the shown layout; it needs Neovim 0.10+.

gitview.about: Replaces the Changes panel (cmd-shift-g sidebar, cmd-g tab). Its installer downloads the herdr-gitview binary of the release, checked against its SHA-256.

file-icons.about: Herdr's Files panel with Material icons, in a split (cmd-shift-f). filetree reads its icons.

filetree.about: A file tree with icons in the Files slot of the side panel.

agent-flow.about: The agents of a space as a graph (ctrl-shift-g overlay, cmd-alt-g split), patched to draw orc.py handoffs.

better-tabs.about: The tab bar: tabs drag to reorder, wrap onto more lines (the bar grows through the Skills panel's tabs-row) and name themselves after what runs in them, as real renames that keep a name you typed; a ⋮ menu holds panel buttons. Runs no programs and reaches no network.
